caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design of a dress, primarily shown in a three-quarters front view, with a smaller back view sketch positioned to the upper right. The dress is rendered in light tones, likely representing a pale or white fabric, with delicate gray and black pencil shading to indicate folds and contours. The main dress features a fitted bodice with a high, ruffled collar and long sleeves ending just above the wrists. Down the center front of the bodice and along the front edge of the skirt is an ornate line of decorative buttons or embellishments. The skirt is full and reaches the floor, adorned with vertical seam lines suggesting multiple panels, and a rectangular overskirt drapes over the right hip, finished at the edge with a border of round decorative elements. The hem of the skirt and the overskirt are also trimmed with a border of round or looped decorations. The smaller back-view sketch reveals that the dress has a closely fitted back and a sash or ribbon tied at the waist, with the same decorative edging at the hem and overskirt. The background is a plain, uncolored surface.
title: Wedding Dress
